GROUP BY c.state_code
ORDER BY valor_vendido DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.state_code AS estado,
    COALESCE(cat.category_name_english, p.category_name) AS categoria,
    SUM(oi.price)::numeric(18,2) AS faturamento

  LEFT JOIN olist.categories cat ON cat.category_name = p.category_name
  GROUP BY c.state_code, COALESCE(cat.category_name_english, p.category_name)
),
top_estados AS (

  FROM base

)
SELECT ce.estado, ce.posicao, ce.categoria, ce.faturamento
FROM cat_estado ce
WHERE ce.posicao <= 3
ORDER BY (SELECT faturamento_estado FROM top_estados t WHERE t.estado = ce.estado) DESC, ce.posicao;
